purpose: One independently authored surreal concept, not a control-level calibration experiment.
concept: Soft solid-marble curtain in an alteration room
requester_owned_topic: Explicit prior-user surreal topic carried by the coordinator-frozen topic context.
authorial_realization: A solid mineral sheet behaves like loose fabric while a person lifts its lower corner.
reference_scope: Face and hair appearance only; no identity, actual age or personality inference.
competing_readings: A rigid stone sculpture already carved into curtain folds

gates.criterion: The broad curtain and its held edge read as the same solid mineral, including continuous gray veins and an exposed thick mineral/chipped cross-section; printed fabric alone fails.

The mineral-looking curtain visibly has deep cloth-like folds and its held lower corner curls around the fingers in one still state; a rigid-looking carved silhouette without the intended contact and curl fails this visual criterion. This does not prove actual material softness or motion.
The stone identity cues and soft cloth behavior coexist on one continuous curtain, with the person's actual hand contacting its lifted edge.
Face and short dark bob with fine wispy bangs are visibly guided by the supplied reference; this is appearance guidance, not verified identity.

separate_evidence_layers: New CID source review and inspiration decision
Whole-source native qualification if independently earned
evidence_limit: A still image can support co-visible forms, mineral-like appearance, folds, curl, cross-section and contact. It cannot establish actual physical material, ductility, a deformation process or real motion.
